summary: A two-man team with a shoulder-fired Javelin missile. It is fire and forget: after launch the missile finds its own way onto a tank's thin top armour. It is fragile, slow to move and nearly helpless against infantry that reaches it.

sections.title: Anti-tank missile
sections.how: Select the Javelin team and left-click an enemy vehicle, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The missile climbs and falls onto its target from above, where armour is thinnest. Once it is away the team needs no further aim. It punches through tank armour and destroys light vehicles. Against infantry it does little, it cannot hit aircraft, and it has a minimum range: anything that gets too close is safe from it.

sections.title: Stow and set up
sections.how: Select the team and left-click the ground; on touch, tap.
sections.body: The team cannot walk with the launcher ready. It first stows the launcher on its shoulder, walks, then readies the launcher again on the new spot, and only then can it fire. Give the move order before the enemy arrives, not in the middle of a duel.

sections.title: Fight from a trench
sections.how: Select the team and left-click a finished trench, or press Garrison.
sections.body: Inside a trench the team is protected: small arms and most fire only graze it, though high explosives and thermobaric shells wear the trench down and can destroy it. It fires its missile out at vehicles. When an enemy holds the next piece of the line, the team switches to its sidearm and fights as infantry, never firing the launcher point-blank, and in a trench line it advances from piece to piece toward the enemy. Press Unload to get out.

sections.title: Garrison buildings
sections.how: Select the team and left-click a civilian building, or press Garrison.
sections.body: The team takes cover inside and fires from the windows with more range and damage. The building changes hands to your side while they hold it and returns to neutral when they leave. A wrecked building throws them out, and one that collapses can kill them.

sections.title: Heal at the barracks
sections.how: Select damaged Javelin teams and left-click your barracks.
sections.body: They walk in and heal for free while the barracks keeps training. A patient leaves on its own when whole. If the barracks is destroyed or sold, the patients are thrown out.

sections.title: Dig trenches
sections.how: Select the soldiers, press Dig trench and left-click the ground. Drag to draw a line; Shift turns a single trench or keeps the button armed after a line.
sections.body: A squad digs a two-cell trench; more diggers finish faster. A finished trench halves the damage its infantry take, and a section with a roof protects the first two soldiers completely. Wheeled vehicles cannot cross it once it is half dug; tracked vehicles and infantry can.

sections.title: Repair bridges
sections.how: Select one or more soldiers and left-click a damaged or broken bridge.
sections.body: The soldiers walk to the bank and repair the bridge for free. Every worker adds a share, up to six; a dozer counts for three. A broken bridge opens again once it is repaired enough to carry traffic.

tips: Stow the launcher before a move: the team must ready it again before it can fire.
Keep it behind a tank or in a trench; in the open it dies to the first infantry squad that reaches it.
In a trench line it fights with a sidearm at close quarters, so back it with Rangers.
It cannot hit drones or aircraft; pair it with a Humvee or Rangers that can.
